header.title: Sediment Sample Schema
header.description: JSON schema for sediment sample submissions.

air_temp_regm.description: Information about treatment involving an exposure to varying temperatures; should include the temperature, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include different temperature regimens

alkalinity.description: The ability of a solution to neutralize acids to the equivalence point of carbonate or bicarbonate (Unit: mg/L or meq/L)

alkyl_diethers.description: Concentration of alkyl diethers. Provide value and unit, any unit is valid

alt.description: Heights of objects such as airplanes, space shuttles, rockets, atmospheric balloons and heights of places such as atmospheric layers and clouds. It is used to measure the height of an object which is above the earth's surface. In this context, the altitude measurement is the vertical distance between the earth's surface above sea level and the sampled position in the air. For ARM this can be a range. (Unit: m)

ammonium.description: Concentration of ammonium in the sample. (Units: umol/L or mg/Liter or ppm)

analysis_type.description: The type(s) of analysis planned for this sample.

annual_precpt.description: The average of all annual precipitation values known or an estimated equivalent value derived by such methods as regional indexes or Isohyetal maps. (Unit: mm)

atmospheric_data.description: Measurement of atmospheric data; can include multiple data

bacteria_carb_prod.description: Measurement of bacterial carbon production. Provide value and unit, any unit is valid

biotic_regm.description: Information about treatment(s) involving use of biotic factors such as bacteria, viruses, or fungi.

biotic_relationship.description: Description of relationship(s) between the subject organism and other organism(s) it is associated with. The target organism is the subject of the relationship and the other organism(s) is the object

bishomohopanol.description: Concentration of bishomohopanol. (Unit: ug/L or ug/g)

calcium.description: Concentration of calcium in the sample (Unit: mg/L or umol/L or ppm)

carb_nitro_ratio.description: Ratio of amount or concentrations of carbon to nitrogen.

chem_administration.description: List of chemical compounds administered to the host or site where sampling occurred, and when (e.g. Antibiotics, n fertilizer, air filter); can include multiple compounds. For chemical entities of biological interest ontology (chebi) (v 163), http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/chebi

chloride.description: Concentration of chloride in the sample (Unit: mg/L or ppm)

chlorophyll.description: Concentration of chlorophyll (Unit: mg/m3 or ug/L)

collection_date.description:
'The date of sampling as an instance. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Also valid if entire collection date is unknown is just year (YYYY) or just year and month
(YYYY-MM)'

collection_time.description: The time of sampling as an instance (single point). Required format: HH:MM:SS in 24-hour time format. Don't forget the second! (Unit: hh:mm:ss or HH:MM:SS)

crop_rotation.description: Whether or not crop is rotated, and if yes, rotation schedule

cur_land_use.description: Present state of sample site. This slot is NOT multivalued. Valid entries: badlands, cities, conifers, crop trees, farmstead, gravel, hardwoods, hayland, horticultural plants, industrial areas, intermixed, marshlands, meadows, mines, quarries, mudflats, oil waste, pastureland, permanent snow or ice, rainforest, rangeland, roads, railroads, rock, row crops, saline seeps, salt flats, sand, shrub crops, shrub land, small grains, successional shrub land, swamp, tropical, tundra, vegetable crops, vine crops

cur_vegetation.description: Vegetation classification from one or more standard classification systems, or agricultural crop

cur_vegetation_meth.description: Reference or method used in vegetation classification

density.description: Density of the sample, which is its mass per unit volume (aka volumetric mass density) (Unit: g/m3 or g/cm3)

depth.description: The vertical distance below local surface. For sediment or soil samples, depth is measured from sediment or soil surface respectively. Depth is required to be reported as an interval for subsurface samples. (Units: m)

description.description: Human-readable description for the entity or activity

diether_lipids.description: Concentration of diether lipids; can include multiple types of diether lipids (Unit: ng/L)

diss_carb_dioxide.description: Concentration of dissolved carbon dioxide in the sample or liquid portion of the sample (Unit: umol/L or mg/L)

diss_inorg_carb.description: Dissolved inorganic carbon concentration in the sample, typically measured after filtering the sample using a 0.45 micrometer filter (Unit:  ug/L or mg/L or ppm)

diss_org_carb.description: Concentration of dissolved organic carbon in the sample, liquid portion of the sample, or aqueous phase of the fluid. (Unit:  umol/L or mg/L)

diss_org_nitro.description: Dissolved organic nitrogen concentration measured as: total dissolved nitrogen - NH4 - NO3 - NO2. Provide value and unit, any unit is valid

diss_oxygen.description: Concentration of dissolved oxygen. (Unit: umol/kg or mg/L)

drainage_class.description: Drainage classification from a standard system such as the USDA system

elev.description: Elevation of the sampling site is its height above a fixed reference point, most commonly the mean sea level. Elevation is mainly used when referring to points on the earth's surface. (Unit: m).

emsl_activity.description:
Nullable string linking a Sample or SamplingActivity to a named EMSL activity or
campaign (e.g., 'AMP2', 'MONet_FY26'). Optional for historical records
predating activity tracking.

env_broad_scale.description: 'Report the major environmental system the sample or specimen came from. The system identified should have a coarse spatial grain to provide the general environmental context of where the sampling was done (e.g. in the desert or a rainforest). We recommend using subclasses of EnvO''s biome class: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_00000428. EnvO documentation about how to use the field: https://github.com/EnvironmentOntology/envo/wiki/Using-ENVO-with-MIxS'

env_local_scale.description: 'Report the entity which are in your sample or specimens local vicinity and which you believe have significant causal influences on your sample or specimen. Please use terms that are present in ENVO and which are of smaller spatial grain than your entry for env_broad_scale.If needed, request new terms on the ENVO tracker identified here: http://www.obofoundry.org/ontology/envo.html'

env_medium.description: 'Report the environmental material immediately surrounding the sample or specimen at the time of sampling. We recommend using subclasses of ''environmental material'' (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_00010483). EnvO documentation about how to use the field: https://github.com/EnvironmentOntology/envo/wiki/Using-ENVO-with-MIxS.'

experimental_factor.description: Experimental factors are essentially the variable aspects of an experiment design which can be used to describe an experiment or set of experiments in an increasingly detailed manner. This field accepts ontology terms from Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) and/or Ontology for Biomedical Investigations (OBI). For a browser of EFO (v 2.95) terms please see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/EFO; for a browser of OBI (v 2018-02-12) terms please see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/OBI

experimental_factor_other.description: Other details about your sample that you feel can't be accurately represented in the available columns.

external_identifiers.description: List of external identifiers associated with this entity or activity.

extraction_method.description: If you (the user) performed an extraction preparation or processing before sending the sample to EMSL, what was it? This is only applicable when sending an 'analytical sample'. See README for more details on types of samples.

extreme_event.description: Unusual physical events that may have affected microbial populations. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

fao_class.description: Soil classification from the FAO World soil distribution from International Soil Reference and Information Centre (ISRIC). The list of available soil classifications can be found at https://www.isric.org/explore/world-soil-distribution

fire.description: Historical and/or physical evidence of fire. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

flooding.description: Historical and/or physical evidence of flooding. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

gaseous_environment.description: Use of conditions with differing gaseous environments; should include the name of gaseous compound, amount administered, treatment duration, interval, and total experimental duration; can include multiple gaseous environment regimens

geo_loc_name.description: The geographical origin of the sample as defined by the country or sea name followed by specific region name and site. Formatted as [Country or sea names: region or state, site]

growth_facil.description:
Type of facility or location from where the sample was collected or
grown. This field is NOT multivalued. If selecting other, add the `other_growth_facil`
attribute to provide additional detail.

humidity_regm.description: Information about treatment involving an exposure to varying degrees of humidity; should include amount of humidity administered, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimens

isotope_exposure.description: List isotope exposure or addition applied to your sample.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the sampling site in WSG 84 format.

light_regm.description: Information about treatment(s) involving exposure to light including both light intensity and quality.

link_class_info.description: Link to digitized soil maps or other soil classification information

local_class.description: Soil classification based on local soil classification system

local_class_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining the local soil classification

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the sampling site in WSG 84 format.

magnesium.description: Concentration of magnesium in the sample (Unit: umol/kg or mol/L or mg/L or ppm)

mean_frict_vel.description: Measurement of mean friction velocity (Unit: m/s)

mean_peak_frict_vel.description: Measurement of mean peak friction velocity (Unit: m/s)

methane.description: Methane (gas) amount or concentration at the time of sampling. (Unit: umol/L or ppb or ppm)

method_development.description: If your samples are TEST sample ONLY, please provide information on what you're hoping this test will resolve.

micro_biomass_c_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining microbial biomass

micro_biomass_n_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining microbial biomass nitrogen

microbial_biomass.description: The part of the organic matter in the soil that constitutes living microorganisms smaller than 5-10 micrometer. If you keep this you would need to have correction factors used for conversion to the final units. (Unit: g/kg sediment or ug/g sediment)

microbial_biomass_c.description: The part of the organic matter in the soil that constitutes living microorganisms smaller than 5-10 micrometer. If you keep this, you would need to have correction factors used for conversion to the final units. Provide value and unit, any unit is valid

microbial_biomass_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining microbial biomass

microbial_biomass_n.description: The part of the organic matter in the soil that constitutes living microorganisms smaller than 5-10 micrometer. If you keep this, you would need to have correction factors used for conversion to the final units. Provide value and unit, any unit is valid

misc_param.description: Any other measurement performed or parameter collected that is not listed here

n_alkanes.description: Concentration of n-alkanes; can include multiple n-alkanes (Unit: ug/mL)

name.description: Human-readable name for the entity or activity.

neon_plot_id.description: When sampling from a NEON site provide the plot ID from which you sampled. This includes the 4 letter site code followed by the 3 digit ID (Example: DEJU_048). If you do not have your NEON site use the code SITE_999.

neon_site_code.description: When sampling from a NEON site provide the 4 letter site code (Example: DEJU). If you do not have your NEON site use the code SITE_999.

nitrate.description: Concentration of nitrate in the sample (Unit: umol/L or mg/L or ppm)

nitrite.description: Concentration of nitrite in the sample (Unit: umol/L or mg/L or ppm)

non_microb_biomass.description: Amount of non-microbial biomass measured. Include the name for the part of biomass measured, e.g.insect, plant, total. Provide value and unit, any unit is valid. (example: insect 5mg; plant 2ug/mL)

non_microb_biomass_method.description: Reference or method used in determining biomass

org_carb.description: Concentration of organic carbon. Provide value and unit any unit is valid

org_nitro.description: Concentration of organic nitrogen. Provide value and unit any unit is valid

org_nitro_method.description: Method used for obtaining organic nitrogen

other.description: Other/additional details about your sample that you feel can't be accurately represented in ANY of the available columns.

other_growth_facil.description: Please specify growth facility if you selected 'other'

other_samp_store_temp.description: Please specify sample storage temperature if you selected 'other'

other_storage_condt.description: Please specify your storage conditions if you selected 'other' and the available values are not appropriate

other_treatment.description: Many sample treatment descriptor columns are available. If a treatment is applied to your samples and the provided treatment terms do not satisfy please add it here. Multiple treatments can be entered here separated by ;

oxygen_status.description: The relationship of the sample to oxygen, such as aerobic or anaerobic.

part_org_carb.description: Concentration of particulate organic carbon. Provide value and unit, any unit is valid.

particle_class.description: Particles are classified based on their size into six general categories: clay, silt, sand, gravel, cobbles, and boulders. Include amount of particle with units preceded by the name of the particle type; can include multiple values separated by ';'.

perturbation.description: Type of perturbation, e.g. chemical administration, physical disturbance, etc.; coupled with perturbation regimen, including how many times the perturbation was repeated, how long each perturbation lasted, and the start and end time of the entire perturbation period; can include multiple perturbation types

ph.description: pH measurement of the sample or liquid portion of sample or aqueous phase of the fluid

ph_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining ph of the sample

phaeopigments.description: Concentration of phaeopigments; can include multiple phaeopigments separated by a `;` (Unit: mg/cm3)

phosplipid_fatt_acid.description: Concentration of phospholipid fatty acids; can include multiple values separated by `;`. Provide the phospholipid fatty acids followed by the measurement value ({phospholipid fatty acid name}{value} {unit})

porosity.description: Porosity of deposited sediment is volume of voids divided by the total volume of sample. (Unit: percent)

potassium.description: Concentration of potassium in the sample (Unit: mg/L)

pressure.description: Pressure to which the sample is subject, in atmospheres (Unit: atm)

previous_land_use_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining previous land use and dates

profile_position.description: Cross-sectional position in the hillslope where sample was collected. Sample area position in relation to surrounding areas

project.description: Identifier for the user project associated with the entity or activity.

redox_potential.description: Redox potential measured relative to a hydrogen cell indicating oxidation or reduction potential (Unit: mV)

replicate_number.description: The replicate number of the sample, if applicable. Included for compatibility with submission schema.

salinity.description: Salinity is the total concentration of all dissolved salts in a sample. While salinity can be measured by a complete chemical analysis, this method is difficult and time consuming. More often it is instead derived from the conductivity measurement. This is known as practical salinity. These derivations compare the specific conductance of the sample to a salinity standard such as seawater (Unit: practical salinity unit or percent)

salinity_method.description: Method used to determine sample salinity

samp_store_temp.description: The temperature at which your samples should be stored upon arrival. This field is NOT multivalued. If selecting other add the `other_samp_store_temp` attribute to provide additional detail.

sample_collected.description: This refers to the TOTAL amount of sample collected from the experiment. NOT the amount sent to EMSL or collected for a specific analysis. Provide value and unit, any unit is valid

sample_collection_dev.description: The device used to collect an environmental sample. Include dimensions of device if applicable

sample_collection_method.description: The method used to collect an environmental sample. This can be a citation or description.

sample_link.description: 'A unique identifier to assign parent-child subsample or sibling samples. This is relevant when a sample or other material was used to generate the new sample. This field allows multiple entries separated by ; (Examples: Soil collected from the field will link with the soil used in an incubation. The soil a plant was grown in links to the plant sample. An original culture sample was transferred to a new vial and generated a new sample)'

sample_name.description:
The name or label that is present on the shipped sample. This should
be a human readable name.

sample_processing.description: A brief description of any processing applied to the sample during or after retrieving the sample from environment or a link to the relevant protocol(s) performed.

sampled_at_site.description: Reference to the site where the sample was collected. This is a FK to the Site class, which contains detailed metadata about the sampling location.

sampled_during.description: Reference to the sampling activity during which this sample was collected. This is a FK to the SamplingActivity class, which contains metadata about the sampling event, such as date, device, method.

season_precpt.description: The average of all seasonal precipitation values known or an estimated equivalent value derived by such methods as regional indexes or Isohyetal maps. (Unit: mm)

sediment_type.description: Information about the sediment type based on major constituents

shipped_sample_size.description: Total amount of sample sent to EMSL. Must include units.

sieving.description: Collection design of pooled samples and/or sieve size and amount of sample sieved

slope_aspect.description: The direction a slope faces. While looking down a slope use a compass to record the direction you are facing (degrees); e.g. 315 degrees. This measure provides an indication of sun and wind exposure that will influence soil temperature and evapotranspiration. (Unit: degrees)

slope_gradient.description: Commonly called 'slope'. The angle between ground surface and a horizontal line (in percent). This is the direction that overland water would flow. This measure is usually taken with a hand level meter or clinometer. (Unit: percent)

sodium.description: Sodium concentration in the sample (Unit: ug/mL)

source_mat_id.description: A unique identifier assigned to an original material sample collected or to any derived sub-samples. The source material should be listed as a sample to inform details about parent material relationship.

start_date_inc.description: Date the incubation was started. Only relevant for incubation samples. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

storage_condition.description: The storage condition of the sample. This field is NOT multivalued. If selecting other add the `other_storage_condt` attribute to provide additional detail.

storage_condition_other.description: Free-text field for storage conditions when 'storage_condition' is 'other'

sulfate.description: Concentration of sulfate in the sample. (Unit: umol/L or mg/L or ppm)

sulfide.description: Concentration of sulfide in the sample. (Unit: umol/L or mg/L or ppm)

technical_reps.description: Number of technical replicates for the sample.

temp.description: Temperature of the sample at the time of sampling. (Units: C)

tot_carb.description: Total carbon content. Provide value and unit, any unit is valid

tot_depth_water_col.description: Measurement of total depth of water column (Unit: m)

tot_nitro_cont_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining the total nitrogen

tot_nitro_content.description: Total nitrogen content of the sample. Provide value and unit any unit is valid

tot_org_c_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining total organic carbon

tot_org_carb.description: Total organic carbon content. Provided as gram of Carbon per kg of your sample material. (Unit: g C/kg)

turbidity.description: Measure of the amount of cloudiness or haziness in water caused by individual particles. Provide value and unit any unit is valid.

water_content.description: Water content measurement. Provide value and unit any unit is valid

water_content_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining the water content of soil

watering_regm.description: Information about treatment involving an exposure to watering frequencies, treatment regimen including how many times the treatment was repeated, how long each treatment lasted, and the start and end time of the entire treatment; can include multiple regimens

weather.description: The state of the atmosphere at a given time and place with respect to variables such as temperature, moisture, wind velocity, and barometric pressure.
